description: Bounded unweighted Kernighan-Lin bisection of a module netlist, including repeated best-positive-prefix passes.

pinned_source.license_note: Pinned source headers identify Todd M. Austin, ECE 756, dated 1993-02-25, but contain no explicit license or redistribution grant. The implementation is clean-room and does not copy source text or KL-4.in.

contract.net_member_rule: Each member identifier is distinct within its net and lies in 0..module_count-1.
contract.source_mode: Default KS_MODE-off, unweighted Kernighan-Lin branch; WEIGHTED and KS_MODE are not enabled by the pinned launcher.
contract.initial_partition: First half of module IDs in A and second half in B.
contract.tie_break: Scan current A order, then current B order; retain the first candidate on equal gain.
contract.pass_behavior: Greedily select each opposite-side pair, temporarily swap it, accumulate gains, commit the first best positive cumulative prefix, and repeat until no positive prefix remains.

output.meaning: Packed group-A membership mask, cross-side module-pair cut count, cut-net count, and accepted improving passes.

oracle.method: For each greedy candidate pair, independently construct the trial partition and recount all cross-side pairs and cut nets in every hyperedge.
